title: Individual who threw sex toy at Dream-Sparks game arrested, banned from league: Source
content:
The individual who tossed a green sex toy onto the court during a game between the Los Angeles Sparks and Atlanta Dream on Thursday has been arrested and indefinitely banned from all WNBA, NBA and affiliated league games and events, a league source familiar with the matter confirmed to The Athletic.

The person hurled the toy during the third quarter of the Dream’s 124-88 win, recalling a trend that began last season when objects were thrown onto the court at various games. The sex toy was tossed in front of the Sparks bench as Los Angeles forward Jihyun Park was at the free-throw line.

Before Park attempted her free throw, a referee blew her whistle to stop play. Dream forward Angel Reese quickly pointed out the perpetrator from her seat on the bench; Crypto.com Arena security removed the toy and apprehended the spectator. According to the LAPD, officers arrived at the arena shortly after 8:30 p.m. to meet with security, who had detained the individual. LAPD identified the individual as a male in his mid-20s and said he trespassed after throwing the object onto the court. Officers issued the individual a citation, and he was released on site. Therefore, no names have been released.

The WNBA plans to work closely with law enforcement to hold individuals accountable for throwing objects onto the court, according to the source, who spoke on the condition of anonymity because they weren’t authorized to speak publicly about the matter.

Sex toys being thrown onto the court became an issue last season in July, when an object was thrown onto the court across six games, including in Atlanta, Chicago, New York, Phoenix and Los Angeles. Police arrested two people — 18-year-old Kaden Lopez in Phoenix and 23-year-old Delbert Carver in Georgia — as they were behind a group money scheme with cryptocurrency.
